description: The image shows a Windows desktop with DBeaver (database management tool) open on the left side, displaying SQL code with syntax highlighting. The SQL query visible includes statements like "FROM times x LEFT JOIN source x" and "SELECT table_size, table_name, table_owner" with yellow, green, and white text highlighting. On the right side is a dark terminal/console window showing execution output with text including "Breakdown:", "PRE queries:", "POST queries", timestamps like "2023-Jun22-Jun23", and a summary line reading "Total processed this time: 2 PRE - 14 POST - 16 queries;". The user appears to be reviewing database query results after running a batch of SQL queries. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom with various application icons including File Explorer, PyCharm, and other development tools.

The image shows Extended Login IDE (likely DBeaver or a similar database management tool) with a SQL query editor open on the left side, containing a query that selects table_size, table_name, and time_created fields with various filtering conditions including table name pattern matching. On the right side, there is a dark terminal/console output window displaying "Breakdown" information showing PRE and POST quarters data, with entries like "2022-1a(2) through 3a(2) (inclusive)" and processing statistics indicating "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters." The user appears to be reviewing database query results related to quarterly data processing, with the cursor visible in the terminal output area. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 8:30 AM.

The image shows DBeaver database IDE on Windows, with a SQL query editor on the left displaying a query involving table joins and schema information (visible code includes `FROM tiles t LEFT JOIN spm sampler s`, `ON t.table_name = s.table_name`, and references to `table_size`, `table_rows_time_created`). On the right side, there is a terminal/console window showing execution output with a "Breakdown" section listing "PRE" and "POST queries" with timestamps from 2022-2023, and a summary line stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom with various application icons, and the user appears to be reviewing database query execution results.

The image shows DBeaver (database management application) running on Windows, with a SQL query visible in the editor pane on the left side. The query appears to be selecting table metadata (table_size, table_name, time_created) from what looks like a BigQuery information schema. On the right side is a dark terminal/console window showing "Breakdown" statistics with "PRE queries - 2 queries" and "POST queries 3e22 through 5e23 (inclusive)" followed by timestamped entries (2023-3q22-4q22, etc.) and a summary line "Total processed this time = 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to be reviewing query execution results, with the cursor positioned in the terminal output area. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 8:58 AM.

The image shows Extended Logic IDE (or similar SQL development environment) on Windows, with a SQL query visible in the editor panel on the left side. The query includes SELECT statements working with table_name, table_size, and table_rows columns, with syntax highlighting showing keywords in different colors. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window displaying execution results with a "Resolution" section showing "PRE queries... 2 quarters" and "POST queries: (null) through Apr21 (inclusive)" with various date entries (2021-3rd/2-4rd/2... etc.), and a final summary line "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 5:30 AM.
